india.one_line: Indian courts examine AI copyright, IIT Delhi expands tribal translation, and startups secure new funding.

themes.title: Delhi High Court examines AI copyright
themes.text: The Delhi High Court is examining an appeal to recognize an AI system as an author under copyright law.

stories.headline: Delhi High Court to examine if AI can be author under copyright law

themes.title: IIT Delhi expands tribal translation platform
themes.text: IIT Delhi and the Ministry of Tribal Affairs released Adi Vaani to support speech-to-speech translation for ten tribal languages.

stories.headline: Adi Vaani platform expands AI translation for tribal languages

themes.title: AI startup M raises funds
themes.text: Dunzo cofounder Kabeer Biswas' AI startup M secured $9 million in funding led by RTP Global.

stories.headline: Dunzo cofounder Kabeer Biswas' AI startup M raises $9 Mn
